label: رسمي
note: Primary: Xbox Wire 'Free Play Days' 29 Oct 2026 (15:00Z): WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers, Darkwood, Spirittea and EVERSPACE 2 free for Game Pass Ultimate, Premium and Essential members from Thu 29 Oct until Sun 1 Nov; Dead by Daylight free for all Xbox members 28 Oct to 2 Nov on console. Pictures: each game's Steam launch trailer, gore-free stretches only (DBD and WUCHANG checked). Sound: our bed (neon): the footage crosses five trailers, so no one stretch fits, as on the PS Plus list of 28 Oct. Darkwood is named in the caption only: its Steam trailer is letterboxed to 482 rows (4x) and its capsule art is 600x900, both under the quality floor. v2: DBD beat rebuilt from the survivor at the table, the flashlight man and survivors running (v1 showed a killer with a raised blade, then dark frames and a dark binoculars close).
